plugin_desc: SNMP monitoring template for Telco Systems / BATM BiNOS ethernet switch. It reports uptime, CPU utilization, and interface traffic (enterprise PEN 738).
name: Switch

metrics.name: device_cpu_usage
metrics.description: This metric reports the CPU utilization of the Telco Systems / BATM BiNOS ethernet switch (monCpuUtilization) as a 0-100 percentage. Sustained high CPU usage can indicate control-plane overload, forwarding instability, or attack traffic.

metrics.name: snmp_uptime
metrics.description: This metric indicates the uptime of the device since the last restart. By monitoring the uptime, network administrators can understand the stability and reliability of the device and identify potential reboot or failure issues.
